[P3] Revisit the untested singular-error branch

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” is unmet. The single-error tests check only `startswith("1 validation error")`, which also accepts `"1 validation errors"`. Always choosing the plural therefore satisfies every added assertion, leaving the singular branch without an observable regression test. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and decide whether this formatting distinction belongs in the required behavior and how the agreed test plan will establish it.
